headline: Cabot Shares Fall 2% Despite Beating Earnings Estimates on Weaker Margins
summary: Cabot shares fell 2% despite beating consensus earnings estimates, weighed down by weaker operating margins.
why: Cabot Corporation is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company whose margins reflect raw material cost pressures and industrial demand.

impacts.name: Cabot
impacts.why: Weaker profit margins overshadowed an earnings beat, causing a decline in the company's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investor concerns over compressed profit margins outweighed an earnings beat, leading to a share price pullback.
